name: :Lockdown Lovers
source:
After being stuck in the house for months during the outbreak of a new virus, you find yourself missing the outside world and basic human contact. You're four months into the lockdown, when you find yourself confused by the sudden realisation that you are not alone...

[From [url=https://lovers-in-lockdown.itch.io/lockdown-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在新病毒爆发期间被困在家里几个月后，你发现自己错过了外面的世界和基本的人际接触。你已经进入封锁四个月了，当你发现自己突然意识到你并不孤单时感到困惑……

[来自[url=https://lovers-in-lockdown.itch.io/lockdown-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
